mapper.select: SELECT id, type_code, type_name, unit, ratio_min, ratio_max, status, sort_order, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_energy_type ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, type_code, type_name, unit, ratio_min, ratio_max, status, sort_order, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_energy_type WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT id, type_code, type_name, unit, ratio_min, ratio_max, status, sort_order, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_energy_type WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, type_code, type_name, unit, ratio_min, ratio_max, status, sort_order, remark, create_time, update_time FROM t_energy_type WHERE type_code = #{typeCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_energy_type (type_code, type_name, unit, ratio_min, ratio_max, status, sort_order, remark) VALUES (#{typeCode}, #{typeName}, #{unit}, #{ratioMin}, #{ratioMax}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{remark})
